bug_semantics: PluginImportGuard.restore_hidden_modules() restored saved entries, cleared self.hidden_modules, and only then evaluated len(self.hidden_modules), so every restoration audit message reported zero regardless of the number restored. In setup, hide_dangerous_modules() deleted blocked modules from the process-global sys.modules before sys.meta_path.insert(0, import_guard) installed the blocking finder; a thread scheduled between those two operations could re-import a deleted blocked module and retain access to it, bypassing the intended sandbox in a multi-threaded process.
flaw_origin: Commit e588aaa3a53ef291406b02745c20fdea8cea7f7c newly added PluginImportGuard and both causal mechanisms in openssl_encrypt/modules/plugin_system/plugin_sandbox.py: the clear-before-count restoration log and the non-atomic hide-then-install ordering. Its direct parent had no PluginImportGuard, hide_dangerous_modules(), or restore_hidden_modules().
